body:
Allylescaline Second Trial
Judging from how much it upset my stomach the first time, I decided to make a couple adjustments, which was make sure I had an empty stomach, and no alcohol or anything extra, except for weed, after ingesting the allylescaline, because it would help calm my stomach. I made sure not to eat for around 5-6 hours (last time it might have been extra greasy food that made me feel so bad, who knows?) and start with a smaller dose,  and increased it gradually over time instead of taking a lot at once. I actually ended up taking more this round then I did the first time. Dosage was as follows:
15 mg and 30 minutes later +10mg. About +2-2.5 hours I took 10 mg again and then 20-30 minutes after that took an additional 10.
The trip seemed to take a little less time to kick in, this time after the walk with the dog and a shower (+45 min) I was starting to feel a weird tingling feeling throughout my body, but no visuals. After I got my room situated I lay back with the lights off waiting, and playing a game on my phone, and checking shroomery posts. About +2 hours I noticed I was hardly getting any CEV, it felt like any minute now it would be very hard to read, andI was noticing a lot of movement in the semi-dark room I turned the light on. I could see a quilt hanging on the wall fluttering like in a breeze, but obviously there wasn't one. The floor tiles looks really fluffy again, but not changing colors like last time. My body felt good so I decided to dose again. After that I went back online and tried to read.
The screen on my phone gained a weird depth/bulge to it where letters were either sunken in a few inches or bulging out a bit. Some were right next to each other, and the script kept changing from normal, to just about anything, Gothic, comic, bubbles, newsprint, etc. The scripts kept rolling over it in waves and it got really hard to read 4 dimensional font changing print! I decided to put my phone down and meditate, with the light on but pointed down so it was dim.
I began to see very weird CEV, and with something over my eyes (hands, blanket etc.) It seemed they could be projected about a foot or so, meaning that if there was anything visual 12' or so away, I couldn't see the CEV (with open eyes) because I would be seeing something else, in a darkened room (lights make it almost impossible to see CEV with open eyes).
These were weird looking blobs of colored light that kept shrinking and forming larger blobs (which were about the same original size) and then the now tiny different colored blobs would pop off and scatter and vanish and it would happen again. It would form slight pictures of inanimate objects like it was trying to show me something unfamiliar looking. I began to meditate, and for some reason an essay I had seen earlier popped into my head as a fact. It was a very weird paper, explaining somewhat like the death/rebirth people feel while on high doses of LSD. This paper, written as a fictional dialogue between certain people discussed how certain races came to earth from other galaxies and reasons how and why we are here, angels, really off the wall stuff, but written as if true. Right before this point, I had redosed the last time. I feel as if I was hearing voices telling me certain things making me think about the essay. Nothing was vocalized but I began to feel kind of paranoid that maybe parts of it could be true, so I began to read a book to see if I could read.
It was now about 4 am. I tried to read, but the subject matter of the book I was reading was way too heady for me (basically how to achieve ego death while not on psychedelics) and I began to feel the third and fourth doses kick in, the letters in the book began doing the same thing as before, although a bit subdued on the depth changes so it was easier to read (although some letters looked as though I could fall in them) I put the book down and went out to smoke a blunt which made me feel really good, as if I was getting really high from the AL but the weed was a little buzz I was getting, to keep me relaxed for the ride.
I went inside and ate a bowl of cereal, and watched the floor wave around like water in a pond, then went back downstairs. I still had a tremendous amount of headspace so I started reading another book... Bad idea! I picked one on the history of Aztecs, which from their personal history says that they were the last of the earths children to leave a cave in a mountain. I began to get mental imagery of a rocketship falling into a mountain and then people coming out (because of the earlier essay I had seen, I think it might have been my mind trying to rationalize it), thinking it was a cave, and then basically living and dying as a priest, farmer, king, warrior, etc for a thousand  years or so, until Cortes arrived, which was the subject matter of the book (what the Aztecs did and how they did it up until Cortes. These mental images I was getting wasn't as much visuals although I did get lots) as they were feeling certain things and seeing pictures in the book of objects the Aztecs used, and knowing how it was used.
I had a massive headspace with this trip, and I lengthened it quite a bit with the redosing.
I eventually fell asleep around +12 hours and woke up a few hours later feeling like I hadn't slept.
